title: How Much Does Quattr Cost?
metaTitle: How Much Does Quattr Cost? (2026 Pricing)
metaDescription: Quattr publishes no prices and gates them behind a demo. Third-party sources report ~$79–$599/mo. Here's what's actually known about Quattr's cost in 2026.
shortAnswer: Quattr does not publish prices on its website — its pricing page sends you to "Book a Demo" instead. Third-party review sites report paid plans in the range of roughly $79/month (Individual) to $249/month (Pro) to $599/month (Team), with custom enterprise pricing on request. Quattr offers a free trial and a handful of free single-purpose AI SEO tools, but to see real numbers for your account you'll need to book a sales call. Reviewers commonly describe the pricing as "rather steep for a generative AI platform."
intro:
Quattr is an AI-native SEO, AEO, and GEO platform aimed at teams that want to win rankings and citations across Google and AI search. It's a legitimate, well-reviewed tool — but if you're trying to answer the simple question "how much does it cost?", you'll hit a wall: there are no prices on Quattr's own site.

This page lays out exactly what's publicly known about Quattr's pricing in 2026, where the published numbers come from (and why they should be treated as estimates), and how to decide whether it's worth booking the demo. We'll also flag where a free, no-demo option makes sense if you just want a quick read on your AI visibility first.

sections.heading: The short version: Quattr's pricing is demo-gated
sections.body:
Quattr's pricing page (quattr.com/pricing) does not list a single price. Instead it presents a "Book a Demo" form with the pitch "Personalized to your site. 30 seconds to book." There are no named tiers, no monthly numbers, and no public feature-by-plan comparison on Quattr's own site.

That's a deliberate enterprise sales motion: Quattr wants to scope your domains, traffic, and goals before quoting. The upside is you get pricing matched to your situation. The downside — and the reason people search this question — is that you can't compare Quattr against alternatives on cost without first giving up your contact details and sitting through a sales conversation.

So if your honest goal right now is "I just want to know the ballpark before I talk to anyone," Quattr's site won't give it to you directly. The numbers below come from third-party review platforms, not from Quattr, and should be treated as estimates that may not match your final quote.

sections.heading: What third-party sources report (≈$79–$599/month)
sections.body:
Several review aggregators have published Quattr tier pricing, even though Quattr's own site does not. As of 2026, commonly reported plans are:

- **Individual — ~$79/month:** roughly 80 Copilot drafts/mo, ~10 AI-scored URLs/mo, 1 user, up to 2 domains.
- **Pro — ~$249/month:** unlimited Copilot drafts, ~30 AI-scored URLs/mo, 2 users, up to 5 domains.
- **Team — ~$599/month:** unlimited drafts, ~75 AI-scored URLs/mo, 4 users, unlimited domains.
- **Enterprise — custom:** quoted on request via the demo.

Treat these as directional, not gospel. Because they aren't published by Quattr, they can lag behind current packaging, omit annual discounts, or differ from what sales actually quotes you. Other listings (Capterra, GetApp) simply say "Contact vendor" with no number at all, which tells you how inconsistent the public record is. The reliable takeaway: expect a starting point near $79/month and meaningfully higher for multi-domain or team usage.

sections.heading: Is Quattr expensive? What reviewers actually say
sections.body:
The most common pricing critique in independent reviews is that Quattr is "rather steep for a generative AI platform." Reviewers who like the product still note the cost can be hard to justify for solo operators or small sites, and they point to cheaper content-and-SEO tools — Scalenut (Starter around $59/month) and SEO AI among them — when budget is the deciding factor.

That said, "expensive" is relative to what you're replacing. Quattr bundles AI content drafting, automated internal linking, page scoring, and AI-search visibility tracking into one platform with consulting support. If it consolidates two or three separate subscriptions plus freelancer time, the Pro or Team tier can pencil out. If you only need occasional content optimization, paying $249–$599/month is likely overkill.

The fair verdict: Quattr isn't overpriced for what it is — a full enterprise SEO/AEO suite — but the opacity makes it feel risky, and the entry price is high relative to single-purpose tools.

sections.heading: Free options: trial and standalone tools
sections.body:
Quattr does offer ways to touch the product before paying, though both come with limits:

- **Free trial:** A trial is bundled with the demo signup (reviews reference a roughly 14-day window). You generally still go through the demo/contact step to start it.
- **Free AI SEO tools:** Quattr publishes several free single-purpose utilities — a title generator, heading generator, meta-description generator, and keyword research tool, among others. These are genuinely free and useful for one-off tasks, but they're not the full platform and don't include the visibility tracking, scoring, or automation that justify the paid tiers.

So there is a free on-ramp, but the meaningful evaluation — your real domains, your real rankings, your real AI-search visibility — still sits behind the demo gate and, ultimately, a paid plan.

You don't need to book a demo to answer that.

faqs.q: Does Quattr show pricing on its website?
faqs.a: No. Quattr's pricing page does not list any prices or named plans. It presents a "Book a Demo" form and says pricing is personalized to your site, so you have to go through a sales call to get real numbers.

faqs.q: How much does Quattr cost per month?
faqs.a: Quattr doesn't publish this, but third-party review sites report approximately $79/month for an Individual plan, $249/month for Pro, and $599/month for Team, with custom enterprise pricing on request. Because these come from aggregators rather than Quattr, treat them as estimates.

faqs.q: Is Quattr expensive compared to other SEO tools?
faqs.a: Reviewers frequently describe Quattr's pricing as "rather steep for a generative AI platform" and point to cheaper alternatives like Scalenut (around $59/month) for budget-conscious users. Whether it's worth it depends on whether Quattr replaces several other tools and freelance work for your team.

faqs.q: Does Quattr have a free trial or free version?
faqs.a: Yes to both, with limits. A free trial (reviews cite roughly 14 days) is bundled with the demo signup, and Quattr also offers several free standalone AI SEO tools like a title generator and meta-description generator. The full platform still requires a paid plan after the trial.
